description:
Create a new bibliographic entry in your Jurism library for a specific book chapter. You must select the correct item type ('Book Section') and accurately enter the metadata, distinguishing between the chapter author and the book editors.

Details to enter:
- Item Type: Book Section
- Title: Natural Law: The Modern Tradition
- Author: Brian H. Bix
- Book Title (Publication Title): The Oxford Handbook of Jurisprudence and Philosophy of Law
- Editors: Jules Coleman AND Scott Shapiro
- Publisher: Oxford University Press
- Date: 2002
- Pages: 61-103

The task is complete when the item is saved in your library with all fields correctly populated.

metadata.target_book_title: The Oxford Handbook of Jurisprudence and Philosophy of Law
